lines: A note from mid-ride now reaches the team. The backend stores it and answers two hundred and one.
Each report keeps its kind, message, context and, for a bug, the packet log and app version, with the rider's account and the time. Without a session, four oh one.
Ten reports an hour per rider. The eleventh gets four twenty-nine, with the wait, and the dialog keeps the note to try again.
The team reads reports with the feedback command, as JSON Lines: a rider by id, never by email, and the message as text, never as HTML.
The acceptance tests failed first and pass now. Telemetry counts feedback by kind, and never carries the message, the context or the packet log.
The thanks, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
